topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: There it is, in the chaotic sea of forgotten things—a flea-bitten, threadbare bear with a single, melancholic eye. My heart lurches. It’s impossible, yet there he is, sitting forlornly on a tattered blanket, under a tarp flapping in the wind. The yard sale buzzes around me, but all I can focus on is the familiar patch of worn velvet on his ear, the way his stuffing has settled, the slight tilt of his head. People jostle past, oblivious, and I know I have to act. I dig into my pocket, fingers fumbling for coins, desperate to claim him before anyone else can. Just a few more seconds, and he’ll be mine again.
